description: asdlc: keep bug fixes from editing the tests that judge them, and log every hook decision

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'asdlc: uv is not installed, so the test-edit guard did not run. Install uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; }; uv run --quiet --script "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard_test_edits.py"
